agreement_semantics.EFFECT-C108: every candidate the grounded verifier marked compatible (may endorse more than one key)
agreement_semantics.EVIDENCE-E108: the single evidence-conditioned candidate-action key (plus a stable boundary key when one was acquired)
agreement_semantics.caveat: the two endorsement channels are different in kind; the agreement axis is therefore only loosely comparable across splits

conditions.description: valid candidate-action state AND the three votes are not unanimous AND a pair boundary for {primary, challenger} is registered in the frozen decision graph (the stable-edge-support floor).
candidate disagreement, with the registered-pair-boundary requirement dropped: fire on every disagreeing pair whether or not the frozen graph carries a stable-edge-supported boundary for it.
conditions.legality: runtime-legal but requires new graph edges

conditions.description: fire whenever the speech-only primary disagrees with the speech-only retrieval rank-1 key; needs only the first two contacts.
fire whenever the primary disagrees with the evidence-conditioned candidate-action state.
fire whenever the retrieval rank-1 key disagrees with the candidate-action state.
union of C2/C3/C4: any disagreement among the three logged votes, boundary registration ignored.
conditions.legality: runtime-legal but requires new graph edges

conditions.description: unconditional acquisition on every query (the cost ceiling).
fire whenever the gold key is not the retrieval rank-1 key; reported only as the diagnostic upper reference for a perfect gap detector.
fire whenever the primary is already wrong; the diagnostic set a perfect gap detector would target.

fired_precision_recap.reading: of the 7 acquisitions actually flown, 4 were attributable transitions and all 4 were helpful, 0 harmful; the other 3 were unresolved. Precision on the attributable subset is 4/4

stable_edge_support_gap.note: these are queries where the loop DID detect a candidate disagreement but the frozen decision graph carried no stable-edge-supported boundary for that pair, so no acquisition was possible

frame: iteration-tier, model-free, zero service contacts; outputs are DESIGN INPUTS for the DEV-100 campaign's starting knobs; NO verdict clause attaches; no promotion claim; FINAL60/DEV ladder/devel/test untouched

headline.selection_rule: best-cell-by-worst-split on per-split DELTA vs that split's own primary; never best-by-single-split

c108.parser: reader M6 field contract mirrored in analysis.m11_operating_point_sweep.load_c108_records

blend_layer_ceiling.note: a decision layer that only re-ranks the logged candidates can never exceed this; it is the count of queries whose gold key is inside (logged top-k UNION {primary})

EFFECT-C108.logged_retrieval_channel: ordered key-id list only; no score was recorded
EFFECT-C108.refined_list_note: the registered reader scores top-k reachability on the REFINED list; this sweep blends over the speech-only INITIAL list so the two splits stay schema-parallel
